scope: Root-dispatched PR181 normal managed auth-refresh follow-up, same worker/Agent/native; no lifecycle transition executed

officialContract.meaning: Managed refresh-token flow; completion is not selected-account replacement or inference/tool access proof.

implementation.normalPath: Authenticated control HELLO/ATTACH capability -> original managed adoption history/identity checks -> managed refresh observation; current cold/adopted owner exposes same refresh method.
implementation.protection: Failed refresh gates subsequent provider dispatch before its permit, retaining healthy host and admitted input. No replay/restart/login-mode switch.
implementation.retryBoundary: Resident outcome retained for identical normal supplied credential bytes held privately in memory only; changed supply may reopen official refresh. No token digest/log/persistent secret or parallel retry engine.
implementation.projection: Only COMPLETED/chatgpt, fixed FAILED code, or UNAVAILABLE/HOST_CAPABILITY_MISSING leaves the Agent endpoint. Official account email/token fields are not forwarded.

newFocusedAuthChecks.kind: Production normal-adoption state/Agent endpoint/official-RPC boundaries with synthetic native responses; not live refresh success

cases: Exact official refresh params and sanitized projection
Old capability/invalid attachment sends no unsupported request
Native token_revoked blocks new dispatch without inference-success claim or input replay
Provider/phase/token-parameter substitution refused before native call
Unchanged supplied credential cannot reconsume OAuth; changed supply permits refresh and clears later-dispatch failure gate

remainingLimits: Existing live host cannot hot-update its in-memory method allowlist/capability. No live official-refresh or shell success obtained.

Minimum target-only lifecycle proposal sent to root, not executed: graceful exact UID retirement, actual stop/storage proof, same Agent protected home/native checkpoint in a new attempt/host. No Node/shared infrastructure action.

Any approved new COLD must bind the explicitly selected fresh task credential source; existing preparation otherwise writes the configured bootstrap source. No account-selection policy was invented or global credential pointer changed.
Original seq6 ADMITTED is never automatically retransmitted; root must decide lifecycle/input handling. No direct pipe injection, hidden login, privileged Pod/sysctl/RBAC or writer-fencing change.
